merlin, a tumor suppressor protein related to the Erm family of proteins that link the actin cytoskeleton to the plasma membrane, binds to phosphatidylinositide 4,5- bisphosphate (PIP2), a lipid found in the plasma membrane, through a motif in its amino-terminal FERM (four-point-one, ezrin, radixin moesin) domain.
merlin is a bona fide phosphoinositide-binding protein and its phosphoinositide interaction with the membrane is required for its function.
